test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: In a class of 60 students (boys and girls), there are 60 % girls. In an examination, the average score of the boys is 52 and that of the girls is 65. What is the average score of the whole class?
solution:
**Given:**

Total students = 60

Average score of the boys = 52

Average score of the girls = 65

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/number of elements

**Calculation:**

Number of girls = 60 × 60%

⇒ 36

Number of boys = 60 - 36 = 24

Now,

Total score of the boys = 24 × 52

⇒ 1248

Total score of the girls = 36 × 65

⇒ 2340

Total score of the total students = 1248 + 2340

⇒ 3588

Average = 3588/60

⇒ 59.8

**∴ The average score of the whole class is 59.8.**
